title: Paramount Syntex IPO Details
intro:
Paramount Syntex IPO is a book build issue of ₹81.79 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 64.40 lakh shares of ₹81.79 crore.

Paramount Syntex IPO opens for subscription on Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Oct 6, 2026. The allotment for the Paramount Syntex IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 7, 2026. Paramount Syntex IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 9, 2026.

Paramount Syntex IPO is set issue price band at ₹119 to ₹127 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,54,000 (2,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,81,000.

Sobhagya Capital Options Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is MNM Stock Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Paramount Syntex IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 1996, Paramount Syntex Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing of synthetic fibres, dyed fibres, and various types of yarns, including acrylic, polyester, wool, nylon, and blended yarns. The Company’s manufacturing units are located at Village Mangarh, Machiwara Road, Kohara, Ludhiana, Punjab, with a combined area of approximately 7,268.73 sq. yards.

Paramount Syntex operates with a fully integrated setup comprising fibre processing, tow dyeing, hank dyeing, spinning, bulking, and packing facilities, supported by an in-house research and quality control team. The Company also manufactures recycled acrylic fibre from waste materials sourced both domestically and internationally, ensuring sustainable operations and efficient resource utilization.

Over the years, the Company has established a strong presence in the textile and apparel industry, supplying high-quality yarns and fibres to a wide customer base across India. It holds certifications including ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management), ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health & Safety), and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP).

faqs.question: How to apply in Paramount Syntex IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Paramount Syntex IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Paramount Syntex IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Paramount Syntex IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Paramount Syntex IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: The Paramount Syntex IPO opens on Wed, Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Tue, Oct 6, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Paramount Syntex IPO?
faqs.answer: Paramount Syntex IPO lot size is 1000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,54,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Paramount Syntex IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Paramount Syntex IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Paramount Syntex IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Paramount Syntex IPO will be done on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Oct 8, 2026 . Check the Paramount Syntex IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Paramount Syntex IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Oct 9, 2026 .
